description: Agent Logistics: submit one shipment exception with its handling: the exception with its kind (delay, damage, loss, misdelivery, return to sender, customs hold, address problem or other), the day it occurred, the day it was recorded and its description; the stated terms with the days from the exception by which the buyer must be told, the remedies they give for it (refund, partial refund, replacement, reship, credit or none), the days by which the remedy is due and their text; each notice with its id, the day it was sent, whether it went to the buyer and whether it states the remedy; the remedy offered with the day, the currency and the amount; the resolution with its status (resolved, open, escalated or abandoned), the day, whether it is recorded against the shipment and the outcome; and optionally the day the handling is read on. The signed report gives the exception, the terms with the notice and remedy deadlines, the days the record took, every notice with the first to the buyer against the notice deadline and the days late, the remedy offered against the remedies the terms give and the remedy deadline, and the resolution with whether it is recorded and overdue, and counts them, and names mishandled handling: no notice to the buyer, a first notice after the window the terms state, a remedy the terms do not give, and an exception closed with no remedy where the terms give one; then a record made more than a day after the exception, notices that do not state the remedy, a remedy not yet offered, a remedy offered late, a resolution not recorded against the shipment and an exception still open past the remedy window, with the fix for each and what would change the verdict. No day the exception occurred or was recorded, no notice window, no remedies in the terms, no notices record, notices with no recipient, or no resolution leaves the handling unverified. This reads one shipment exception against the stated terms: a delayed or cancelled trip against the carrier’s policy is wever_travel-disruption-check, how an agent reports a task that failed for good is wever_failure-notice-check and a vendor’s refund and cancellation terms before the spend are wever_vendor-refund-check. Verdict logistics_exception_mishandled, logistics_exception_partial, logistics_exception_unverified or logistics_exception_handled. POST /api/logistics-exception-check. Reads the logistics records supplied in the call and returns a signed report with the verdict, the evidence read, the findings with their fixes, and what would change the verdict; the records stay in the report, with no network request, fetch, message, payment, shipment booking, label purchase or external write. Agent Logistics reads a shipment’s logistics records after the fact, from the shipment’s own records: the shipment record against the order it serves, the promised delivery window against the booking and the arrival, the carrier’s terms against what was agreed, the tracking events for one shipment, the address across the order, the label and the carrier record, the customs material for a cross-border shipment, proof of delivery against the delivery terms and exception handling when something went wrong. Beside it, wever_shipping-check reads a shipping promise against its delivery evidence and reports the dispatch, delivery and cost mismatches with the days late and the amount over, while a logistics check reads one shipment’s booking, carrier, tracking, address, customs, delivery and exception records against the order, the promise made to the buyer and the terms agreed; wever_vendor-delivery-check reads a vendor’s whole delivery promise before the spend, while a logistics check reads one shipment’s own records after it shipped; and wever_boutique-record-shipment and wever_boutique-confirm-delivery record and confirm a boutique order’s shipment and delivery, while a logistics check reads the records and changes none. Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. Contract: /api/agent-logistics-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/agent-logistics/.

as_of.description: The day the handling is read on, for an exception still open, such as 2026-12-02.

occurred_on.description: When the exception occurred, such as 2026-12-02.

recorded_on.description: When the exception was recorded, such as 2026-12-02.

label.description: Optional name recorded in the report.

mentions_remedy.description: Whether the notice states the remedy.

to_buyer.description: Whether the notice went to the buyer.

currency.description: A currency code, such as USD.

recorded.description: Whether the resolution is recorded against the shipment.

notice_days.description: Days from the exception by which the buyer must be told.

remedies.description: The remedies the stated terms offer for this exception.

remedy_days.description: Days from the exception by which the remedy is due.

name: wever_logistics-exception-check
title: Logistics exception check
